prompt: Which country was the first outside of Africa to detect a case of mpox in the most recent outbreak? Note that the first human cases were diagnosed in 1970.
answer: **Sweden**—it detected the first mpox case outside Africa in the 2024 clade I outbreak, reported on **15 August 2024**. (The first outbreak outside Africa overall occurred in the United States in 2003.)
